It is not a window, cutoff, first moment, entropy, strict-peak topology, half-profile match, amount weighting, peer synchronization, return statistic, or terminal-factor combination.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_range_clock_variance_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock whose completed-session intrabar uncertainty is distributed across widely separated clock positions rather than concentrated in one narrow episode may reflect sustained information assimilation, and that persistent broad discovery state may carry from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.source_grid: Require the immutable raw 241-row stock-day identity, select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude standalone 09:30, and preserve all 240 fixed clock positions.
selected_candidate.formula: For i=0,...,239 set q_i=log(high_i/low_i), Q=sum(q_i), p_i=q_i/Q, and u_i=i/239. Set mu=sum(p_i*u_i) and return 4*sum(p_i*(u_i-mu)^2).
selected_candidate.normalization_reason: For a probability distribution supported on [0,1], population variance is at most 1/4; multiplying by four maps the exact statistic to [0,1] without fitting, clipping, or changing ranks.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require all 240 selected high and low values finite and strictly positive with low<=high, finite nonnegative q_i, and finite Q>0. Exact high=low contributes q_i=0 at its unchanged clock. No minimum positive-range count, adjacent-pair count, peer count, imputation, epsilon, smoothing, threshold, dropped bar, or replacement is allowed.
selected_candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session 15:00 bar; no later session, peer benchmark, daily return, quarterly state, Candidate49 observation, or provider request enters the factor.
